nodes.text: Left Alone
The Handsome Triumvirate are left alone with the body of young Aria.
All right. We need to think.
Jesus, he just ditched us, didn't he.
No, he's still here — this is just a moment we need to share together without his voice in our heads.
The air is different, a certain dramatic gloom hangs about it. The music in my head is dredg, nordic runes etched into my back.
Still we carry with us primal tools he gave to which we possess these gifts of elseworld make — perhaps Disingenuous design.
Quiet, I hear him in your voice — wait, no, he's in all our voices. I can feel his presence in this world. He's always been here, always looking.
Have you gone mad, Faust? You were the one who introduced him to us. How can he be in us when you yourself were the source?
Did not dream this. This is no dream, or is it? Don't know what to make of any. Don't like how words feel coming out my mouth.
Wagner puts his hand on his friend's shoulder.
We're here for you, dude. Don't get all knocked askew. Life is all about shattering these doors of perception wide open.
Jacob grimaces and does the same.
You got us into this mess, you'll get us out, and you'll become a cliche and get the girl in the end.
Faust stands up, wiping tears from his eyes.
Some part of me is always a stupid child, learning so much from every moment. How can adults turn this off and forget the joy of discovery?
Faust stands a beat.
Yeah, he's in us. Rock on.

opts.text: Take one last look at the room.

nodes.text: The office is very quiet without his voice in it.
They proceed to leave the club.
Outside, the world is a wash of color and activity. They see everything in strange new ways, so bright shiny new and overwhelming.
Whoa.
Now we're playing with power.
If this is what being close to death is like, then sign me up because I'm sold. I feel like a full blown rockstar, every step I take trembles ridiculous.
There is a guitar riff buried deep, echoing out a lonesome wail into the stardust aether of 'all and right' — and we Sirs are most definitely all and right.
